tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search published AI SDR, cold email, LinkedIn automation, visitor ID, and GEO/AEO tools on Growth Ranked by query or category slug.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get full verified specifications, pricing, pros/cons, and source URL for one listed growth tool by slug.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all ranking categories with slugs, URLs, and published product counts.

tools.name: submit_tool
tools.description: Submit an AI outbound, AI SDR, lead enrichment, visitor ID, or GEO/AEO tool. Tiers: free_backlink ($0 with badge link), fast_29 (one-time instant publish), featured_59 (one-time + 30-day category pin). Always preview with dryRun=true first to see the live price and checkout URL details.

tools.name: verify_backlink
tools.description: Verify that a page contains a visible dofollow backlink to Growth Ranked and publish a free_backlink submission.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools, get_tool, list_categories · Public sink: search_tools, submit_tool, verify_backlink.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools, get_tool, list_categories · Public sink: search_tools, submit_tool, verify_backlink

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
